别名

あらすじ

The main character, who loves taking a sneak shot, starts working at a hospital. His target are the girls, Satsuki and Noho, who cause various troubles due to the eternal triangle with Hideyuki, the director’s son. He, who takes a sneak shot of the girls, approaches them with a video tape in his hand…
